points_balance.title: Points balance
points_balance.expiry_note: Some of your points expire soon.

is_active.label: Programme running
is_active.help: When off, members earn nothing here; redemption and expiry go on.

earn_per_minor.label: Points per minor unit spent
earn_per_minor.help: Points a member earns for each minor unit (cent) spent, rounded down; 0.01 is one point per 100 cents.

point_value_minor.label: Point value (minor units)
point_value_minor.help: What one point is worth at redemption, in minor units (cents); 1 means one point takes one cent off.

max_redeem_percent.label: Largest share paid with points (%)
max_redeem_percent.help: The most of an order total points may cover, as a whole percentage; 0 turns redemption off.

expiry_months.label: Points expire after (months)
expiry_months.help: Unspent earned points expire this many months after they were earned.

tiers.label: Tiers
tiers.help: The balances at which an account is promoted; an account is never demoted automatically.

stamps_per_visit.label: Stamps per visit
stamps_per_visit.help: How many stamps one visit adds to a member's stamp card.

stamps_per_card.label: Stamps per card
stamps_per_card.help: How many stamps fill a card; a full card is one reward.

intents: add them to the points programme

freeze.confirm: Freeze this account? The member cannot earn or spend until it is unfrozen.

intents: how many points do I have

insufficient_points.message: You do not have enough points.

not_a_member.message: You are not enrolled in the loyalty programme.
